theme: Skia m151 and managed perf ports
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and ports several hot-path colour and interop helpers to managed C# for speed.
highlights_body: This release ports colour conversion, premultiplication, and HarfBuzz text-shaping helpers to allocation-free managed code, fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData, and adds .NET 11 WASM exception-handling support.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to Chrome milestone m151, folding in several rounds of upstream bug fixes.

bullets.lead: Colour and interop perf ported to managed code
bullets.detail: Ports SKColor to SKColorF conversion, single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, and SKColor hex parsing to managed math, adding ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and removing round-trips through native code.

Makes HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free with pooled UTF-8 encoding, removes per-call char[4] allocations in Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse, and reads SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans.
Removes an unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions, simplifying consumption from safe contexts.
Fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI).
Restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster rendering regression introduced by the Skia update.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions early.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Ported managed colour, premultiply, and HarfBuzz text-shaping perf work, and fixed the SKImage.FromEncodedData resource leak.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Opened the 4.151.0 line by updating Skia to milestone m151 and refreshing the docs pipeline.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Delivered the managed HarfBuzzSharp and colour-parsing performance ports, the CPU raster regression fix, and WASM exception-handling groundwork.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Finished the managed colour/premultiply perf ports, added .NET 11 WASM exception-handling support, and fixed the SKImage.FromEncodedData resource leak ahead of release.

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes HarfBuzzSharp to 14.2.1, bringing the allocation-free Buffer.AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse performance ports along with it.
